'''DecipherCon 1999 Enhanced Sealed Deck''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed deck held in Virginia Beach, Virginia on 13 November 1999. It is known from Martin Akesson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d163">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-09-world-championships-by-martin-akessond163/ world-championships-by-martin-akesson], DeckTech (Martin "Mart" Akesson, 9 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-09-world-championships-by-martin-akessond163/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[DecipherCon 1999]].

* '''Date:''' 13 November 1999
* '''Site:''' Virginia Beach, Virginia
* '''Format:''' [[Enhanced Format Sealed Deck]]
